records.claim: Using olanzapine may raise levels of the hormone prolactin, which may affect male fertility (ability to make healthy sperm). Studies have not been done to see if olanzapine could increase the chance of birth defects. In general, exposures that men have are unlikely to increase the risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes olanzapine, could it affect his fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
